# Clerk

Sign in with Clerk’s official management MCP server at https://mcp.clerk.com/mcp. Choose a workspace and review its permissions. The tools act with your workspace role and manage supported applications, users, configuration and domains. They do not cover every Backend API operation or return instance secret keys.

The separate Secret key connection retains the existing Backend API tools and saved accounts. Select the application and Development or Production at https://dashboard.clerk.com/~/api-keys, then add a secret key. Every mutation requires approval on both transports.
